title: 春宵
author: 苏轼
intro: “A moment of a spring night is worth a thousand in gold” — the poem behind one of China’s best-known sayings about how precious time is.
analysis: 这首诗写春天的夜晚。第一句开门见山：春天的夜晚，哪怕短短一刻，也值得上千两黄金。为什么这么宝贵？第二句回答：花儿散发着清香，月光下花影朦胧。这是从鼻子闻到的、眼睛看到的美。后两句换一个角度：高楼上，富贵人家还在唱歌奏乐，乐声细细柔柔；而挂着秋千的院子里，夜已经深沉、寂静了。一边热闹，一边安静，对比之中，春夜更显得美好又短暂。有人认为后两句也带一点讽刺：有钱人只顾通宵享乐。今天“春宵一刻值千金”常用来比喻美好的时光非常宝贵，要好好珍惜。
analysisEn: A poem about a spring night. The first line gets straight to the point: even a brief moment of a spring night is worth a thousand pieces of gold. Why so precious? The second line answers: the flowers give off a clear, fresh scent, and under the moon their shadows lie soft on the ground — beauty for the nose and for the eyes. The last two lines change the angle. Up in a tower, singing and pipes are still playing, thin and delicate; down in a courtyard where a swing hangs, the night has grown deep and still. Noise on one side, silence on the other: the contrast makes the night feel lovely and fleeting at the same time. Some readers also hear a little criticism in these lines — the rich partying through the night while time slips by. Today 春宵一刻值千金 is a common saying meaning that good times are precious and should not be wasted. (Note: 一刻 was a short unit of time, about fifteen minutes.)
background: Su Shi (1037–1101), also called Su Dongpo, was a Song-dynasty official, poet, essayist and calligrapher. The date and place of this poem are not known.
pronunciation: 值 zhí；阴 yīn（花影）；沉沉 chén chén。
version: 采用通行版本。题目一作《春夜》。

lines.py: chūn xiāo yī kè zhí qiān jīn
lines.lit: One moment of a spring night is worth a thousand in gold;
lines.en: One moment of a spring night is worth a fortune in gold:

lines.py: huā yǒu qīng xiāng yuè yǒu yīn
lines.lit: the flowers have clear fragrance, the moon has shadows.
lines.en: the flowers smell sweet, the moon casts soft shadows.

lines.py: gē guǎn lóu tái shēng xì xì
lines.lit: Songs and pipes in the towers — the sound is thin and fine;
lines.en: From the towers drift faint songs and pipes;

lines.py: qiū qiān yuàn luò yè chén chén
lines.lit: in the courtyard with the swing, the night is deep and heavy.
lines.en: in the courtyard, the swing hangs still, and the night grows deep.

words.en: a moment (literally a quarter of an hour)
words.note: 现代汉语“一刻钟”就是十五分钟。
“春宵一刻值千金”今天常用来说美好时光很宝贵。
这里指月光下的花影；现代汉语“树阴”（也写“树荫”）。
现代汉语“近水楼台先得月”。
现代汉语“暮气沉沉”“死气沉沉”。

imagery.name: 花
imagery.zh: 花的清香是春夜之美的一部分，也说明春天短暂、值得珍惜。
imagery.en: The flowers’ scent is part of the night’s beauty — and a reminder that spring is short.

imagery.name: 月
imagery.zh: 月光照出花影，让春夜朦胧而宁静。
imagery.en: Moonlight casting flower shadows makes the night soft and calm.

imagery.name: 楼
imagery.zh: 楼台上的歌乐代表通宵享乐的热闹，与安静的院落形成对比。
imagery.en: Music from the towers stands for all-night revelry, set against the quiet courtyard.
